decisive_items: T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample
Low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal (20x magnification)
response.rationale: The presence of matching clonal rearrangements in skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow, along with the specific immunophenotypic findings, supports Mycosis Fungoides as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.why: Lack of specific immunophenotypic findings and clonal rearrangements in the bone marrow
